concerns.text: T005 defines latency {0, 50, 100 ms} (3 levels) and a base of 54 runs 'scaled to the plan's replicate count', but the plan mandates 4 latency levels and ~150 runs to exceed the power requirement N≈82. As written, the minimum grid (54) falls below the plan's own sample-size floor — a silent weakening of the plan's statistical constraint. Either match the plan's grid/replicates or amend the plan.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006/T008 vs spec.md:FR-005, SC-006, edge cases; contracts/execution-run.schema.yaml
concerns.text: FR-005 and the spec's edge cases require CPU speed variance and dropout rate as regression covariates, and SC-006 requires checking their presence. The ExecutionRun schema has additionalProperties:false and no cpu_variance or dropout_rate field, so T006 cannot write these predictors and T008 cannot include them without violating the contract. The tasks list silently drops these required covariates.

concerns.location: tasks.md:all phases vs constitution.md:Principle VI; plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Principle VI mandates a discrete-event simulation model validated against a physical deployment of 10–20 machines; the plan includes code/simulation/des_model.py and claims calibration. No task implements the SimPy model, calibration routine, or physical-deployment validation — a constitution constraint dropped from the task list.

The plan mandates iperf3 network calibration and sysbench CPU calibration invoked via `cli.py calibrate` before any sweep, producing data/raw/network_calibration.json and cpu_calibration.json. No task implements the calibrate sub-command or produces these artifacts — a dropped plan constraint affecting measurement validity.

The plan specifies TaskChunk persistence to data/raw/task_chunks/<run_id>.jsonl validated against contracts/task-chunk.schema.yaml. No task creates the schema, the JSONL writer, or its validation step.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T008–T009 vs plan.md:Data Flow / Project Structure
concerns.text: Plan and data-model place model outputs at data/processed/regression_model.json and data/processed/theoretical_bound_validation.json; T008/T009 write to data/results/. Reconcile to one location to preserve Principle IV traceability.

Plan defines code/orchestrator/instrumentor.py with tests/unit/test_instrumentor.py; T002 folds instrumentation into node_manager.py, leaving the plan's instrumentor module orphaned. Either add the module or amend the plan.
Constitution requires random seeds pinned in code/; no task mentions pinning or documenting seeds (e.g., in config.py or sweep_config.yaml).

Spec defers the diminishing-returns threshold as 'subject to adjustment'; T010 hard-codes 0.02 tasks/sec per granularity step with no config artifact making it adjustable. Make the threshold a config value.
